description: Open Sensor Data for Rail 2023 is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Mobilithek. The "Open Sensor Data for Rail 2023" (OSDaR23) has been created as part of a joint research project by DZSF (German Centre for Rail Traffic Research at the Federal Railway Authority), Digitale Schiene Deutschland / DB Netz AG, and FusionSystems GmbH. Coverage: Mobilithek. The portal files it under the publisher Mobilithek. Its tags are automated-train-operation, fid-move, object-detection, railway, sensor. It offers 45 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/BIN. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
